title: prunus × pollardii
intro: Prunus × pollardii, commonly known as the Pollard's apricot, is a hybrid plant that belongs to the Rosaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health issues, including respiratory problems, such as bronchitis and coughs, due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The health benefits of Prunus × pollardii include its antioxidant and antimicrobial activities, which can help protect against infections and oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing.
